instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\base_mm.dxf, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\cover_inch.dxf, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\pin_mirrored.dxf. Import base_mm.dxf, cover_inch.dxf, and pin_mirrored.dxf. Draw a mixed-units assembly: base rectangle (0,0)-(160,70) in millimeters, cover converted from 3.0 x 1.0 inches as rectangle (41.9,80)-(118.1,105.4), pin circle at (80,35) radius 6, mirrored pin reference circle at (125,35) radius 6, and text ACAD-34. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
